title: FloorPlan
description: Vendor-neutral capture result. The Scan Service never emits a provider-specific (e.g. RoomPlan) shape across this boundary — every adapter (RoomPlan, RoomPlan simulator, Android later, third-party SDKs) converts into this contract before it leaves the service. Multi-room sessions (Phase 2) are built from repeated POST /scan-sessions/{id}/capture calls against the same session, each contributing one guided RoomPlan capture's worth of rooms, stitched by the Scan Service into this one result. photos/notes attach to the same result via POST /scan-sessions/{id}/photos and /notes — never a separate side-channel.

scan_session_id.description: Scan Service identifier for this capture session. Never null — a session without one cannot exist (hard constraint #1: identity-native captures).

property_id.description: Vuuro property identifier. Required at session creation, not backfilled later.

capture_provider.description: Which adapter produced this result. The backend's own data model never depends on this value beyond an audit trail.

measurement_basis.description: Honest measurement language (hard constraint #2). 'indicative_nen2580_inspired' is the only value any adapter in this repo may currently produce. 'certified_survey' is reserved for a future QC path that does not exist yet and must never be set by an automated adapter.

purpose.description: Why this scan was taken. First-class per the brief's 'ops memory' principle, not an afterthought tag.

capture_location.description: Session-wide (not per-room), set once from the first capture call that reported it and never overwritten to null by a later one. Null when location permission was denied or never asked — never fabricated. No public exposure of this exists in this repo (ADR-0003: no public session listing).

confidence.description: The floor surface's own confidence only. See coverage.score for the room-wide signal across every surface.

outline_m.description: Room-local polygon outline in metres: [x, z] pairs, translated so the room's own bounding-box minimum corner sits at (0,0). NOT in a shared/world coordinate frame across rooms — see docs/adr/0002-export-coordinate-frame.md. Never assume two rooms' outlines share an origin or can be laid out relative to each other.

structure_origin_m.description: LIDAR-5/11: this room's [x, z] placement in a multi-room fused structure's shared frame, only when captured together with other rooms via StructureBuilder in one continuous visit. Null for every room captured the ordinary way (single-room, or LIDAR-4 resume-later) — never fabricated. outline_m itself stays room-local regardless; this is an additive offset, not a replacement (see docs/proposals/multi-room-fusion.md).

heading_deg.description: Compass bearing (degrees, clockwise from true north, [0, 360)) of the direction of increasing z in this room's own outline_m frame — i.e. which way true north points relative to this room's own local coordinates, captured once from the device's heading at the moment this room's capture session began. Independent of structure_origin_m: a real compass reading, not derived from ARKit/RoomPlan geometry. Null whenever the device's compass wasn't available or calibrated at capture time (no location permission, heading unavailable, or a client older than this field) — never fabricated or assumed to be 0/north-up. Two rooms only share a heading_deg value when they were captured in the same continuous session (see structure_origin_m); an ordinary tiled room added later has its own independent reading.

openings.description: LIDAR-10: doors/windows/openings this room's capture call reported, with positions — not just the coverage confidence tally. Always present; empty array only when RoomPlan reported none, never omitted. Same room-local coordinate frame as outline_m (see docs/adr/0002-export-coordinate-frame.md) — never a shared/world frame across rooms.

position_m.description: Room-local [x, z] centroid of the opening's captured outline, same frame/translation as outline_m.

height_m.description: LIDAR-10: indicative room height only, derived from captured wall dimensions (hard constraint #2 — never certified). Null when no wall height was reported for this capture call, never fabricated as 0.

volume_m3_indicative.description: LIDAR-10: floor_area_m2 * height_m, indicative only (name says so explicitly — never present as certified volume). Null whenever height_m is null.

objects.description: LIDAR-10: real furniture/fixtures RoomPlan captured for this room. Always present; empty array only when the capture saw none — never invented.

position_m.description: Room-local [x, z] position, same frame/translation as outline_m.

dimensions_m.description: [width, height, depth] as RoomPlan reported them.

room_type.description: A guess at what kind of room this is, live-classified on-device during capture. Primary source is RoomPlan's own CapturedRoom.Section.label (iOS 17+); falls back to a simple fixture heuristic (a toilet means a bathroom, ...) only when RoomPlan reported no sections. Never certified. Null when the on/off toggle was off or neither source produced a guess AND the room type has never been set manually either — guess/guess_source are omitted (not present, not null) rather than fabricated when confirmed was set through POST .../room-type on a room with no live guess.

confirmed.description: The room's actual type as far as a human has said so: the live ✓/✗ prompt during capture, or a later correction via POST .../rooms/{room_id}/room-type. Free text up to 60 characters (not restricted to the app's suggested list — see RoomType::isValidConfirmedValue), so this is not an enum. Null if dismissed/timed out unanswered, or explicitly cleared.

coverage.description: Scan quality signal so a landlord knows a scan is usable before leaving the unit. Aggregated across every surface RoomPlan reported for the capture call that produced this room (floor, walls, doors, windows, openings) — not just the floor's own confidence.

score.description: Mean of per-surface confidence weights (high=100, medium=60, low=20).

usable.description: score >= 70. A threshold this repo defines, not a signal RoomPlan itself provides.

message.description: Human-readable rescan prompt when usable is false; null when usable is true.

photos.description: Attached via POST /scan-sessions/{id}/capture's sibling endpoint /photos. Always present; empty until at least one photo is attached.

url.description: Wherever the image is hosted — either an externally-hosted URL the client already had, or, if the client uploaded real image bytes via POST /scan-sessions/{id}/photo-uploads first (added 2026-08-27), the exact URL that endpoint returned: /scan-sessions/{session_id}/photo-uploads/{filename} under this host. This field's shape didn't change, only what a URL under this host can now mean.

room_id.description: Which room this photo belongs to, matching a rooms[].room_id. Null means unit-level (not tied to one room).

notes.description: Attached via POST /scan-sessions/{id}/notes, edited in place via POST /scan-sessions/{id}/notes/{note_id}. Always present; empty until at least one note is attached.

room_id.description: Null means unit-level, matching photos[].room_id semantics.

updated_at.description: Present only after at least one edit via POST /scan-sessions/{id}/notes/{note_id}.
